此版本为原生架构重建前最后一个版本。
This is the final release before the native architecture rebuild.

## 手柄长按切换

统一手柄 Menu / Options 的长按切换，短按不再误触发。

- 持续按住约 2 秒触发，各类手柄行为一致，无需先松手（[#45](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/45)）。
- 修复按住 Menu 期间修改开关后残留旧计时。
- 修复关闭手柄鼠标模拟或切回手柄时按钮粘滞和多余的 Menu 点击；DualSense 触控板模式不受影响。

## 其他改进

- README 补充 DualSense、Foundation 与诊断的使用说明，以及 HDR10+ 动态元数据的限制。

## 修复

- 修复日志查看器的本地化：日志模式、等级、筛选、搜索和详情遵循应用内的中英文选择，并补齐缺失翻译（[#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)、[#44](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/44)）。

## 此前的候选版本

### RC1

- 全新设置界面：串流、显示、音频、键鼠、手柄和更新各成一页，支持搜索具体选项；串流菜单、连接设置和诊断提示补齐中英文（[#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)）。
- 改进局域网发现（[#33](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/33)、[#35](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/35)）。
- 新增独立的 10-bit SDR 设置；尝试修复 HDR 泛白与过曝（[#22](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/22)、[#29](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/29)）。
- 配合 Foundation Sunshine，支持显示器与虚拟显示器配置，文本和图片剪贴板互通（[#32](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/32)）。
- 新增性能诊断和报告导出（[#31](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/31)）。
- 新增应用内更新和测试版渠道，更新包始终验证签名。
- 支持 DualSense 的电量、动作、震动和灯光反馈，触控板提供透传和 Mac 风格两种模式，长按 Options 切换。
- 修复自由鼠标模式下串流窗口自动抢回焦点（[#21](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/21)、[#40](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/40)）。
- 修复单独 Command 键映射 Windows 键，改善 Ctrl、Shift 和快捷键翻译的按键释放（[#23](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/23)、[#37](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/37)）。
- 修正自定义分辨率输入和码率范围；使用独立的应用身份，可与 Qt 版本共存（[#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)）。
- 尝试修复：锁定鼠标无法移动、控制菜单返回后失去响应（[#24](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/24)、[#49](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/49)）；macOS 12 上开始串流时崩溃（[#26](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/26)）；部分手柄的映射和方向异常（[#25](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/25)）；DNF 中方向键失灵（[#39](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/39)）。

## 候选版本说明

- 本候选版请从发布页手动下载安装，应用内更新渠道准备中。
- 这是预发布版本，欢迎通过对应 issue 反馈；仍然遇到同类问题时，请附上系统版本、主机版本、输入设备和日志。
- 支持 Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 和 HDR10+，不支持时安全回退，最终效果取决于系统、硬件和显示链路；HDR Vivid 暂不可用。
- USB 转发和主机文件是实验性功能，需要支持并启用对应功能的 Foundation Sunshine；主机文件为只读，Finder 挂载另需支持该功能的签名版本。

## Hold-to-switch on controllers

Hold-to-switch with Menu / Options is unified, and a short press no longer triggers it.

- Fires after holding for about two seconds, the same on every kind of controller, with no release needed first ([#45](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/45)).
- Fixed a stale timer left when the setting is changed while Menu is held.
- Fixed buttons sticking and extra Menu taps when leaving mouse emulation or switching back to the controller; DualSense touchpad modes are unaffected.

## More improvements

- The README now covers DualSense, Foundation features and diagnostics, and the limits on HDR10+ dynamic metadata.

## Fixes

- Fixed log viewer localization: mode, level, filters, search and details follow the in-app language choice, and missing translations are filled in ([#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30), [#44](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/pull/44)).

## Earlier candidates

### RC1

- New settings: Streaming, Display, Audio, Keyboard & Mouse, Controllers and Updates each have a page, with search down to individual options; stream menus, connection settings and diagnostic notices are fully in Chinese and English ([#30](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/30)).
- Improved LAN discovery ([#33](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/33), [#35](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/35)).
- Added a separate 10-bit SDR setting; attempted to fix washed-out or overexposed HDR ([#22](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/22), [#29](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/29)).
- With Foundation Sunshine: display and virtual display configuration, and text and image clipboard sync ([#32](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/32)).
- Added performance diagnostics and report export ([#31](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/31)).
- Added in-app updates and a beta channel; update signatures are always verified.
- DualSense: battery, motion, rumble and light feedback, and a passthrough and a Mac-style touchpad mode, switched by holding Options.
- Fixed stream windows taking focus back in Free Mouse mode ([#21](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/21), [#40](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/40)).
- Fixed standalone Command-to-Windows-key handling and key release for Ctrl, Shift and shortcut translation ([#23](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/23), [#37](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/37)).
- Corrected custom resolution input and the bitrate range; the app has its own identity and can coexist with the Qt client ([#41](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/41)).
- Attempted to fix: locked mouse not moving, and the control menu not responding after you return to the stream ([#24](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/24), [#49](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/49)); stream-start crashes on macOS 12 ([#26](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/26)); some controller mapping and direction problems ([#25](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/25)); arrow keys not working in DNF ([#39](https://github.com/skyhua0224/moonlight-macos-enhanced/issues/39)).

## About this candidate

- Install this candidate manually from the release page; the in-app update channel is being prepared.
- This is a prerelease. If an issue persists, please report it on the matching issue with your OS, host version, input device and logs.
- Supports Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 and HDR10+, falling back safely where unsupported; the final result depends on the system, hardware and display path. HDR Vivid is unavailable.
- USB forwarding and Host Files are experimental and need a Foundation Sunshine that supports and enables them. Host Files is read-only; Finder mounting also needs a signed build that supports it.

<details><summary>Detailed changes</summary>

#### RC2

- Fixed log-viewer localization regressions; mode, level, filters, search, and detail views now follow the in-app language selection (#30, PR #44).
- Unified Menu / Options mode switching to a two-second hold across both input paths, including HID devices without waiting for release (PR #45).
- Fixed stale hold state across setting changes; release is required before a new gesture can begin, preventing accidental switches.
- Released emulated mouse clicks and restored controller controls when leaving mouse mode, avoiding stuck buttons and unintended Menu taps while preserving independent DualSense touchpad modes.
- Expanded permanent README guidance for DualSense, Foundation features, and diagnostics, and clarified HDR10+ metadata limitations on macOS.

#### RC1

- Reorganized SwiftUI settings and added option-level search.
- Expanded Chinese and English localization across streaming controls, connection settings, and diagnostics (#30).
- Improved LAN discovery, permission declarations, and address probing when the preferred route is unavailable (#33, #35).
- Fixed background stream windows stealing focus in Free Mouse mode after pointer hover or Command-Tab (#21, #40).
- Fixed standalone Command-to-Windows-key handling and improved modifier release during shortcut translation (#23, #37).
- Attempted to fix mouse movement and menu-return stalls by refining capture and recovery (#24, #49).
- Improved stream startup and native decoding, added an in-window loading indicator, and corrected Metal startup callback configuration.
- Attempted to fix macOS 12 stream-start crashes with layout reentry protection (#26).
- Attempted to fix controller mapping and directional input issues (#25), and expanded DualSense feedback and switchable touchpad modes.
- Refined DualSense tapping, natural scrolling, axis locking, and release handling.
- Added explicit 10-bit SDR negotiation (#22) and attempted to fix washed-out or overexposed HDR output (#29).
- Added Foundation display configuration and improved clipboard compatibility, with text/image synchronization verified (#32).
- Improved native decoding and diagnostics to address smoothness and frame-statistics anomalies (#31).
- Integrated Sparkle and a beta channel, with GitHub-first downloads and an identical signed CNB archive fallback.
- Corrected custom resolution and bitrate controls and isolated the app identity for coexistence with QT clients (#41).
- Attempted to fix DNF arrow-key input by refining shortcut translation and modifier-state handling (#39).

#### Candidate notes

- Dolby Vision 8.1/8.4 and HDR10+ provide capability probing, integration, and safe fallback. Output depends on the system, hardware, and display path. HDR Vivid is unavailable.
- USB forwarding and Host Files are experimental and require the corresponding Foundation Sunshine features. Host Files is read-only; Finder mounting also requires a signed build supporting the required App Group.

</details>
